children: Wesco International strengthened its financing platform with two amendments. The company extended and upsized its asset-based revolving credit facility to $1.85 billion through Sep 17 2031 while lowering interest spreads and expanding certain covenant capacity. Separately, it extended its receivables securitization facility to Sep 17 2029 and increased the purchase limit to $1.75 billion, also reducing the drawn spread. Together, these changes are expected to enhance liquidity, reduce funding costs, and provide added flexibility for ongoing operations and strategic initiatives.
